fields.System.Title: FDN-402 — Query the audit trail
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a supervisor, I want to search the audit trail, so that I can reconstruct what
happened around a discrepancy without reading raw logs.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a date range, when I query, then I get audit rows within it, newest first.
  • - Given a user, an entity type, or an entity ID, then I can filter by any of them.
  • - Given a correlation ID, then I get every audit row from that one original request.
  • - Given a large result set, then results are paginated.
  • - Given a caller without audit permission, then the query returns 403.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform |
| Tables | audit_log |
| Risks | Unindexed queries over a very large table |
| Tests | integration |
